description: A day heading governs the lines beneath it; the heading is not itself an item.
source: Composed for Stage 142 slice 0. Heading-plus-list is the commonest shape in /home/cosmo/sc/archive captures.
content:
Saturday:
- Walmart
- Home Depot
- oil change
notes: Three items, not four: 'Saturday:' is scope, not an errand, and emitting a node for it is the failure this watches for. All three inherit the heading's day, which is the second thing being graded - a segmenter that splits correctly but drops the heading's date produces three items dated today. Saturday from Friday 2026-06-12 is the bare weekday reading, 2026-06-13, not the 'next Saturday' doctrine of finding 48. Deterministic segmentation (Stage 142 candidate 5) should find this trivial; the model-driven path currently has no fixture proving it does.
